fields.description: Palm Grove Villas is Sobha’s four-bedroom beach villa collection on Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Private gardens and pools accompany the homes, within a gated island setting. The developer’s current page distinguishes these residences from the larger Coral Beach villas elsewhere on the island.

sources.label: Palm Grove Villas official project page
Official island brochure: Palm Grove PG-V plans on pages 30–35
Miva broker presentation: combined first-phase villas

reviewCoverage.identity: Official Palm Grove page and PG-V plot references distinguish four-bedroom collection from CB-V Coral Beach.
reviewCoverage.location: Official FAQ confirms Umm Al Quwain despite erroneous Dubai page heading.
reviewCoverage.residences: Four bedrooms only; larger CB-V five/six-bedroom drawings excluded.
reviewCoverage.areas: PG-V numerical panels and actual plans visually inspected on PDF pages 30, 32 and 34.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own official page facilities and private garden/pool description checked.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Official 11.53m inventory reference distinguished from secondary 11m launch.
reviewCoverage.payment: Property Finder 10/50/40 aggregate totals 100; no primary due-date calendar found.
reviewCoverage.handover: Secondary December versus June 2028 references retained as conflict.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official-linked 42-page island PDF includes PG-V plans, with source budget 120 words maximum.

overview: Plot and saleable areas are different measures. Compare the exact villa type and plot before relying on a collection-wide size range.
research.locationNote: On Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain, as stated in the developer’s FAQ. A heading says villas for sale in Dubai; this is contradicted by the same page’s actual location and is not adopted.
research.priceNote: The official page displays AED 11.53m subject to inventory. Property Finder and Luxhabitat retain around AED 11m launch references. A dated unit quote, additional charges and current stock need confirmation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 10% booking, 50% construction and 40% handover. A broker-uploaded Miva presentation corroborates that aggregate. Neither substitutes for a current developer instalment calendar.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder and Luxhabitat report Q4/December 2028. A Miva broker presentation instead gives June 2028 for the combined Coral Beach/Palm Grove first phase. Only the shared year is shown; the quarter and unit completion terms remain unresolved.
